fingerprint_protocol: SHA256 of sorted compact JSON: schema, duplicate policy, mapping file SHA256, all pair hashes/counts/geometry, retained filenames; root-independent
train_class_weight_formula: clip(sqrt(0.02 / max(retained_training_pixel_frequency, 1e-12)), 0.25, 8), absent classes=8, normalize mean to 1
warnings: Subject/animal identifiers are not supplied. Filename time-series may cross splits; this is not a verified subject-independent evaluation.
Very small epithelial/pus regions and few validation-positive images make rare-class scores unstable; report classwise scores and multiple seeds.
Geometry is validated for matching sizes and class IDs; semantic correctness of boundaries is not independently established.
9 exact RGB duplicate groups have disagreeing pixel masks. Kept copies are chosen only by split priority and filename, never label content.
Original policy preserves exact photograph overlap between splits; its evaluation is leakage-affected.
